summary: extractConcepts + summarizeExpansion tokenize with only a length>2 filter (graph.ts:70,139), so 3-letter function words leak into concept/family/domain label matching. Confirmed live in prod 2026-05-28 (corpus v27): the article 'the' substring-matches 'Theology', pulling the whole Theology domain (14 concepts) into nearly every query at domain tier and rendering a spurious 'Theology -> 14 concepts' transparency chip. Answer quality is unharmed (domain tier x0.25 + vector dominance) but it erodes the T16 transparency feature's credibility and adds constant low-grade graph noise. Fix: add a stopword list to a SHARED tokenizer (both call sites duplicate the filter) — do NOT just raise min length, since meaningful 3-letter terms (tao, one, god, sin, ego) must survive. Test: extractConcepts('what is the tao') matches tao, not theology.
